title: Tissue Preparation for CLARITY
author: Seth Currlin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8jihuke

steps.title: Perform PFA Incubation
steps.instruction: Fix trimmed tissues in 4% PFA for 20-24 hours at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Place tissues on a slow platform rocker.

steps.title: Perform Hydrogel Incubation
steps.instruction: Transfer tissues to Hydrogel Solution for approximately 5 days at 4˚C.

substeps.instruction: Keep tubes on a 2-axis rocker for the duration.

steps.title: Polymerize Hydrogel
steps.instruction: Polymerize the hydrogel within the tissue at 37°C for 4 hours with gentle rocking.

substeps.instruction: Add a layer of mineral oil to the tube to deter oxygen exchange from air.

steps.title: Perform Passive Clearing
steps.instruction: Place the tissue in Clearing Solution and maintain at 45˚C with gentle rocking until the tissue is optically clear.
